title: Zeolite-catalysed olefin carbonylation based on tuning spatial confinement
title_zh: 基于空间限域调控的沸石催化烯烃羰基化反应
abstract: Carbonylation is an important process used to produce aldehydes, carboxylic acids and esters1–5 that is usually catalysed by homogeneous metal complexes with ligands and iodide promoters6–12. Koch has reported that protons of mineral acids can also catalyse carbonylation13. Previous studies have demonstrated that Brønsted acidic zeolites can act as a heterogeneous, Koch-type catalyst for carbonylation of alcohols and olefins, but the products in this case are limited to tertiary carboxylic acids14–18. Here we show that targeted use of spatial confinement in a zeolite together with a high CO/olefin ratio can help break this limitation. We report that, with FER zeolite and a CO/olefin ratio of 360, olefin carbonylation can produce primary and secondary carboxylic acids as the main products; ethylene carbonylation to propanoic acid (PA) is achieved with 80% selectivity over 100 h and propylene carbonylation to isobutyric acid (IBA) is achieved with 95% selectivity over 750 h. The propylene and ethylene carbonylation selectivities decrease to 61% and 57%, respectively, as the CO/olefin ratio decreases to 24 and 90, respectively. Experiments in combination with theoretical calculations suggest that T2-O5 in eight-membered ring (8-MR) cavities of FER zeolite are the primary active sites for ethylene carbonylation and T3-O1 in ten-membered rings (10-MRs) are the primary active sites for propylene carbonylation. Our findings open new directions for olefin carbonylation and provide critical insights into the prerequisites for developing new zeolite-based carbonylation processes. The use of zeolites with an appropriate pore structure combined with a high CO/olefin ratio is shown to catalyse olefin carbonylation and produce primary and secondary carboxylic acids as the main products.
abstract_zh: 羰基化反应是用于生产醛、羧酸和酯的重要过程1–5，通常由配体和碘化物促进剂的均相金属络合物催化6–12。Koch报告称矿物酸中的质子也可催化羰基化反应13。先前研究表明，布伦斯坦酸性沸石可作为异相Koch型催化剂催化醇和烯烃的羰基化反应，但此类反应产物仅限于叔羧酸14–18。本文表明，在沸石中有针对性地利用空间限域并配合较高的CO/烯烃比，可突破此限制。我们发现，采用FER沸石且CO/烯烃比为360时，烯烃羰基化可将一级和二级羧酸作为主要产物；乙烯羰基化至丙酸（PA）在100 h内选择性达到80%，丙烯羰基化至异丁酸（IBA）在750 h内选择性达到95%。当CO/烯烃比分别降至24和90时，丙烯和乙烯的羰基化选择性分别下降至61%和57%。结合理论计算的实验表明，FER沸石八元环（8-MR）空腔中的T2-O5是乙烯羰基化的主要活性位点，而十元环（10-MR）中的T3-O1是丙烯羰基化的主要活性位点。我们的发现为烯烃羰基化开辟了新方向，并为开发新型沸石基羰基化工艺提供了关键见解。结果表明，使用具有合适孔隙结构的沸石并配合较高的CO/烯烃比，可催化烯烃羰基化并产生一级和二级羧酸作为主要产物。
